name: test-writer
description: Writes unit tests with edge cases for Python, JavaScript/TypeScript or Go code you paste into the chat: a function, a class or a module. Code reads the source first and lists what is testable (parameters, boundaries of every comparison, raised errors, docstring examples, calls to the network, files, clock or environment that must be mocked); the model then writes pytest, unittest, Jest/Vitest or Go table-driven tests that claim those edge cases by id, and code verifies each claim. The reply lists the edge cases covered and not covered, what was mocked, and marks every expected value the model worked out itself. It never changes or runs your code and never claims the tests pass. Follow-ups: use unittest, more edge cases for X, add tests for another function, as json. Not for code review, explaining code, writing the code itself, end-to-end tests or other languages.

skills.name: Write unit tests with edge cases
skills.description: Unit tests for pasted Python, JS/TS or Go code, covering an edge-case list computed from the source (boundaries, raises, doctests, mocks), with what is and isn't covered. Draft to copy: nothing is run.
examples: Write pytest tests for this function: <paste the code>
Jest tests for `parseAmount` and mock `fetch`: <paste the code>
Go table-driven tests for this package function: <paste the code>
